verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static documentation site generator. Buyers comparing documentation tools can reasonably ask about event webhooks, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions: it covers MDX, plugins, versioning, i18n, search, a CLI and static builds, and probes found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
